_doc: What clean-libs.ps1 strip must leave in Libraries/win64 after a successful prepare.
Strip mirrors the 'Free up some disk space' step of win.yml: only *.lib *.a *.exe *.h *.hpp *.inc *.cmake *.pc and include/, objects-*, cache_keys/ survive.
That is safe only for stages whose consumers read headers and libraries. A stage whose other files are read later must be in keep_whole, otherwise its cache key stays valid while its files are gone.
The guard Telegram/SourceFiles/tests/test_zastogram_libs_keep.py derives every consumer from prepare.py and the client CMake and requires each consumed Libraries stage to be classified here.

keep_whole.patches: recipes and patches applied by many later stages
keep_whole.nv-codec-headers: installed again by the ffmpeg build script
keep_whole.gas-preprocessor: perl tool run by the dav1d, openh264 and ffmpeg builds
keep_whole.tlottie: crate sources compiled by tdesktop_rust (cargo add --path ..\tlottie)

headers_and_libraries.mozjpeg: crashpad and tg_owt read its headers and .lib
headers_and_libraries.openssl3: crashpad, tde2e and tg_owt read its headers and .lib
headers_and_libraries.zlib: crashpad and tde2e read its headers and .lib
